title: AI-901: name the workload by what goes in and what comes out

questions.ask: Speech in one language in, text or speech in another out?
Existing text in, labels, entities, PII or sentiment out?
An image plus a question in, a text answer out?
Invoice, form or call recording in, named fields out?
Text in, a new image out?

otherwise: Prompt in, new text out: generative AI (agentic AI if it also uses tools)
before: Responsible AI from a short story
caption: Name the input and the output of the story, then take the first question that matches.
